thread:
rita: quick update: brought up vireo13b-int4 canary on prod-like traffic. functional/eval pass but hit intermittent OOMs during a synthetic burst run. filing notes here.
omar: paste the error tail?
rita: here's the snippet from the worker that tripped:
```
2026-03-25 11:04:33 ERROR allocator: failed to reserve KV region: need=1.08GB free=760MB
Traceback:
  File \"/opt/runtime/serve/worker.py\", line 358, in serve
    kv.reserve(size)
OutOfMemoryError: cannot allocate 1100MB
```
rita: pattern: long prompts (>700 tokens) + max_new_tokens=900 + microbatching (batch=9) -> spike.
sanjay: smells like slab fragmentation from aggressive int4 packing + temporary per-layer buffers for layer-mix heuristic.
omar: two fast mitigations we can flip as pool overrides: 1) defaults.max_new_tokens=300 for the canary, 2) batching.microbatch_max=6, 3) runtime.kv_soft_reserve_bytes=1GB. low risk and reversible.
rita: I applied those to the canary and re-ran the longtail harness for 35m. no OOMs, P95 latency +14ms, eval delta PPL +0.09, within thresholds.
ci-bot: eval-run vireo13b-int4/longtail: 7k prompts, mean delta ppl=0.09, worst=0.41, threshold=0.5 -> pass.
sanjay: good. longer term: propose per-model allocator tuning: bump slab_size 32MB->64MB for vireo13b-int4, and enable compaction when free_pct<22%. also add per-slab churn metrics.
omar: agree. Also suggest an adaptive routing rule: if prompt_len>512 && cluster_load>0.68 -> route to vireo13b-int8 fallback. cheaper than dropping requests. we'll track cost delta.
rita: created ticket ML-1182: \"vireo13b-int4 canary OOMs 3 allocator tuning + longtail evals\". attaching logs and the canary eval.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary override rollout at 11:30 UTC (runbook RB-ML-525).
infra: adding allocator telemetry: allocator.slab_free_pct, allocator.compaction_events, allocator.churn_bytes. plan to collect 1h histograms and attach to ML-1182.
sanjay: add a CI smoke to model bringup checklist: longtail-smoke-10k (10k prompts >=700 tokens) and a small stress pack to try to reproduce fragmentation.
rita: config snippet used for canary override:
```
model: vireo13b-int4
overrides:
  defaults.max_new_tokens: 300
  batching.microbatch_max: 6
  runtime.kv_soft_reserve_bytes: 1073741824
  routing.fallback_policy: route-to-vireo13b-int8-on-high-load
```
omar: once allocator histograms are in, we'll decide on slab bump. tentatively plan: if compaction_count>1000/day OR churn_rate>50MB/s then slab_size=64MB.
rita: monitoring window 24h. will report back to this thread and close if stable. thanks!
